entries.why: Cursor Slack automations, outside the port's scope
replaced by the three writer agents, which carry its body
installs commander at first run; the port vendors commander and runs scripts through its launcher
a runtime manifest for bootstrap.ts's install; kept for development only
a runtime lockfile for bootstrap.ts's install; kept for development only
the machine lock: runs one heavy command at a time per machine, released by the kernel when its holder dies
the runtime launcher: runs poteto-mode's scripts with Bun, else Node 22.18+, in place of bootstrap.ts's install
commander 14.0.0, the version upstream's bun.lock pins, vendored with its MIT licence so upstream's imports resolve without an install
